verdict.rationale: Shopify ships an official UCP CLI (`npm install -g @shopify/ucp-cli`) with structured commands for catalog search, carts, checkouts and orders. It reuses a locally initialized profile on every request and authenticates machine-to-machine via JWTs minted from Dev Dashboard client credentials, so it can be scripted without a UI. A runtime probe drove the CLI non-interactively with a self-generated profile to search the live catalog and create a real cart, and the raw JSON-RPC MCP endpoints are also directly scriptable. Missing for 10: explicit CI or non-interactive documentation (CI examples, headless flags, exit-code and output-format guidance), guidance on refreshing the 60-minute tokens in pipelines, and a fully unattended path past buyer escalation, which hands off to a browser.
